limits: These unreviewed publisher-train photographs are mechanics inputs, not independent deployment evaluation. Prediction counts, confidence and export parity are not accuracy.

parity_acceptance.rule: Bidirectional one-to-one class/box/score agreement for all returned predictions, plus non-vacuous strong matches.
parity_acceptance.raw_limits: Positionwise raw-query deltas are diagnostics, not claimed equivalent. Query ordering is not an object identity; low-confidence queries differ on these inputs. This does not establish equivalence on other inputs.
